commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.

90+5' 4 - 5 It's in the back of the net! Mathias Pereira Lage flights the free kick into the box, where Lilian Brassier (Brest) peels off his marker and heads it straight into the bottom left corner from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 4:5.
90+4' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+4' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
90+3' Eric Roy has decided to make a change. Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) replaces Romain Del Castillo.
90+3' Bradley Locko (Brest) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
90+2' Great teamplay by Brest as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
89' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Rennes win a corner.
88' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
88' An attempted cross from Adrien Truffert (Rennes) is cleared. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
87' Steve Mounie (Brest) picks up a long through ball, but Steve Mandanda deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
86' That will be all from Martin Terrier who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Fabian Rieder (Rennes).
84' Some neat passing and movement from Brest as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
82' The possession of the ball – 46:54.
80' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
79' 4 - 4 Benjamin Bourigeaud takes the free kick and finds Martin Terrier (Rennes) just outside the six-yard box. He keeps his cool and puts the ball into the back of the net. The score is 4:4.
78' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle. Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) commits a foul after dangerous play. Rennes earn a free kick.
78' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
77' Here comes a substitution. Hugo Magnetti is given a rest as he is replaced by Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
76' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Martin Satriano and he is replaced by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
75' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
74' The substitution has been made. Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) has replaced Azor Matusiwa.
73' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
73' Arthur Theate (Rennes) fires a powerful shot which is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Rennes.
73' Rennes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
73' Surely that's handball by one of the Brest players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
71' Martin Terrier (Rennes) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
71' Kenny Lala beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Steve Mounie (Brest), who smashes a first-time shot high over the bar.
70' That's the end of the game for Mahdi Camara, who is replaced by Jonas Martin (Brest).

68' 3 - 4 What a beautiful moment! Arthur Theate (Rennes) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom right corner. Marco Bizot just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 3:4.

66' 2 - 4 Goal! Mahdi Camara (Brest) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the middle of the net. Steve Mandanda is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 2:4.
65' Steve Mounie (Brest) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
64' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.

62' Desire Doue (Rennes) was close to scoring after a great solo effort and unleashed a promising shot from the edge of the penalty area. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Marco Bizot showed his agility and saved this one.
61' Steve Mounie (Brest) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
60' Brest have a free kick from a promising distance.
59' Baptiste Santamaria will be replaced by Amine Gouiri (Rennes).
59' Here is a change. Jeanuel Belocian is going off and Julien Stephan gives the last tactical orders to Adrien Truffert (Rennes).
58' Guela Doue (Rennes) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
58' A cross into the box from Guela Doue (Rennes) is cleared. The ball is behind the touchline and Rennes will take a throw-in.
56' What was Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

54' 2 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Bradley Locko sends a superb cross into the box. Martin Satriano (Brest) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header into the top left corner, leaving Steve Mandanda beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 2:3.
53' Guela Doue (Rennes) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
52' Jeanuel Belocian (Rennes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball has crossed the sideline. Rennes are taking a throw-in.

51' What a wasted opportunity by Martin Terrier (Rennes)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Marco Bizot makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
50' Marco Bizot displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Martin Terrier (Rennes) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
48' 2 - 2 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Warmed Omari (Rennes), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the bottom right corner of his own goal.
47' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) and Lilian Brassier matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' The free kick is delivered by Romain Del Castillo (Brest) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
45+1' Martin Terrier (Rennes) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.

45+1' Warmed Omari (Rennes) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benoit Bastien has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Brest are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
45+1' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Martin Satriano (Brest) commits a foul and Benoit Bastien immediately signals a free kick.
44' Brest are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.

42' Martin Terrier (Rennes) latches onto a precise cross from the free kick and produces a header at goal from the penalty spot, but his attempt low towards the middle of the target fails to beat Marco Bizot, who makes a decent save.
41' It seemed like Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
40' The current number of corner kicks is 2:4.
38' Lilian Brassier (Brest) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
37' Martin Satriano (Brest) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

36' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
35' Benoit Bastien has a clear sight and sees a foul from Martin Terrier (Rennes).
34' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes it short.
33' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Rennes force a corner. They send men into the box.
32' Lilian Brassier (Brest) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends a cross into the box, but Steve Mandanda comes off his line to gather the ball.
30' Kenny Lala (Brest) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
29' Rennes are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
27' A player from Brest commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
27' Mahdi Camara (Brest) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
25' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
24' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
24' Arthur Theate (Rennes) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
23' The game is interrupted now, Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
23' The foul by Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) was seen by Benoit Bastien who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
22' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) swings in a cross from the corner, but Steve Mandanda reads it well and gathers the ball.
21' The resulting corner from Kenny Lala (Brest) is cleared by the defence. Brest get a corner.
19' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle and it's Martin Terrier (Rennes) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
18' The resulting corner from Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

17' Martin Terrier (Rennes) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Rennes.
17' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
16' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rennes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
16' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) will take the free kick.
16' Mahdi Camara (Brest) receives a fine low pass and attempts to send the ball past the goalkeeper, but his shot goes wide of the goal.
14' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
13' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
11' 2 - 1 Steve Mounie (Brest) is in the right place at the right time. He picks up the rebound and converts it into an easy goal.
11' Steve Mounie (Brest) meets an accurate cross in the box and steers a fine header towards the net. The goalkeeper has to react quickly to keep the ball out.
9' 2 - 0 Goal! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Marco Bizot and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 2:0.
9' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
8' It looks like Mahdi Camara (Brest) saw red with that tackle. Benoit Bastien won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Rennes in a dangerous position.
6' Brest earn a corner.
4' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) was set free in the area by Azor Matusiwa and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
3' One of the players from Rennes times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
2' Unlucky! A rebound falls at the feet of Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest), and he hits a first-time exocet from long range that flies just over the bar.
2' A dangerous looking corner kick from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is cleared to safety by the defence.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Rennes will kick-off.
Benoit Bastien is the one to supervise the game today.
